name: BIND 9
description: Registers your devices in a BIND 9 (or any RFC 2136 compatible) DNS server: an A record and a reverse (PTR) record for every device Netlens knows and DNS does not, and a changed address for devices whose IP changed (DHCP). Reads zones by zone transfer (AXFR) and writes by dynamic update (RFC 2136), both signed with a TSIG key. Every change is guarded by a prerequisite, so a record that changed meanwhile is never overwritten. Netlens only changes records it remembers writing.
author: Netlens
supports: Other RFC 2136 servers with TSIG (not tested)

releases.changelog: First release. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
